title: FreshRoute — Dairy Distribution
subtitle: The morning inventory board this site started as

source.publisher: Kaggle (Dairy Goods Sales Dataset), a static export
source.note: STATIC, not live. A real export downloaded once; every day after, it drifts further from reality and nothing in the file says so. The live board is linked above.

grain.note: The file is a transaction log, not a stock snapshot. Taking the latest row per product × location × brand gives 600 real current items. Summing locations would hide a stockout in one place behind surplus in another.

charts.title: Shortages by location
charts.insight: 19% of tracked positions sit below their minimum stock, concentrated unevenly across 15 locations.
charts.form_why: One measure across named categories, and the category labels are long — horizontal bars read without rotating anyone's head. A map was rejected: the locations are administrative regions, not a spatial pattern.
charts.method: Computed from the cleaned copy after 13 same-day conflicting stock readings were resolved to the lower value (an under-read costs extra inventory; an over-read costs a stockout).
charts.caution: Raw counts per location, not per-capita or per-SKU. The chart labels this explicitly rather than implying that the biggest bar is the worst-run site.

cannot_answer: Anything current. The export stopped in 2022 — every expiry-window feature evaluates against a file whose last recorded day has long passed.
Why anything is unprofitable. There is no cost column, so the data can detect what needs attention but never explain the economics.
